investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Silvermark Academy (online learning); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.77.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster silver-prod-useast (EKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-01, maxmemory 4gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the certificate-svc PostgreSQL database certificate-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
